references.text: The command to destroy the Asherah poles and burn them, as Gideon was instructed to use the Asherah tree as fuel for the burnt offering
Instructions to build an altar for the Lord and offer a burnt offering on it, corresponding to Gideon's mission
Command to destroy the Asherah poles by cutting them down and burning them
Elijah builds an altar for the Lord and offers a burnt offering, parallel to Gideon's building of an altar
David builds an altar for the Lord and offers a burnt offering, similar to the command given to Gideon
Gideon built an altar for the Lord at that same place, the context for this verse
Prohibition against planting an Asherah pole beside the Lord's altar, relevant to the destruction of the Asherah in this verse
